conviction_note: Nothing unpriced and company-level was found: no vinstvarning, no pre-release, and only one sell-side bar (ABG, cut on 19 Oct); the peer Q3 prints (Knowit and AFRY margins up on fewer staff) and Prevas's own H2 cost actions lean mildly positive, while Etteplan's September profit warning (Finland demand) and a former CEO's September share sale lean negative. Both sides are public and the stock has already priced much of each (-17% in early September, +4.9% on Knowit's day), so p_up is 53 on a large move scale: 8%, because this thin name has moved 5-22% on four of its last six prints and the Q3 numbers are entirely new. impact_sum +0.4 and the scaled +0.48 agree in sign and size.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 sales about 345-355 MSEK and adj EBITA close to ABG's 8.4% margin (~29-30 MSEK). The lean is slightly above it, on H1 restructuring savings (11.8 MSEK of costs, with the full Denmark/Skåne effect from H2) and on the peer utilisation read. Unknown on Finland.
order intake and backlog commentary, plus an update on Finland; Prevas gives no numeric guidance, so the tone of the outlook is the forward line. Unknown direction.
Q3 operating cash flow (Q3'25 was 21.3 MSEK) and the overdraft drawdown after the June dividend; Q2 cash was 1 MSEK with 24 MSEK of a 100 MSEK facility drawn. A small risk if the overdraft grows.

findings.finding: Swedish and Nordic consulting peers that reported Q3 last week show margin up y/y on fewer staff and higher utilisation, which is Prevas's own H2 mechanism: Knowit 'Lönsamheten förbättras med bibehållen omsättning trots att antalet medarbetare minskat' (adj EBITA 6.7%), AFRY utilisation 72.9% (72.0) and adj EBITA margin 6.8% (6.4), with organic decline narrowing. ABG's bar assumes a FLAT 8.4% margin for Prevas despite H1 restructuring of 11.8 MSEK whose full effect was guided from H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On actual report dates, Q3'25 (margin up to 8.4% from 7.5%) moved +22.1%, Q3'24 -10.6%, Q2'26 (margin miss vs ABG) -16.1%. This name moves hard on the margin line.
findings.original_quote: Lönsamheten förbättras med bibehållen omsättning trots att antalet medarbetare minskat. (Knowit: profitability improves with revenue held despite fewer employees.) AFRY: 'Debiteringsgraden uppgick till 72,9 procent (72,0)' (utilisation 72.9% vs 72.0%).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Prevas rose 4.9% (55.0 to 57.7) on 23 Oct, Knowit's report day. But the only sell-side bar was cut four days before the peers reported and still assumes a flat margin. If the market had fully priced a margin step-up, the stock would not still trade where ABG puts it at about 6x 2027e EV/EBITA, 40% below peers. This is still a proxy: Knowit also flags Finland as the hardest market.
findings.independence: AFRY Q3 (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b621db1424ad9f573d8a9ff37feef82af&lang=sv&src=listed) is a separate document pointing the same way. Prevas's own Q2 presentation shows 'Improved EBITA outside of Finland' and rising utilisation (https://www.prevas.se/download/18.5bb03e0019f4adbf2f0e42a8/1784270280759/Prevas%20presentation%20Q2%202026.pdf).

findings.finding: The only visible bar was lowered a week before the print: ABG cut adj EBITA 6% for 2026e and 10% for 2027e on 19 Oct ('Likely near the bottom, but not there yet'), citing fewer FTEs and a soft Finland, so the Q3 hurdle is a flat 8.4% margin on organic -1.7%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 missed ABG's adj EBITA by about 18% and fell 16%. No observed case of a print against a freshly lowered bar.
findings.why_not_priced: The cut itself is public. What is unpriced, if anything, is that the hurdle is now easier. Capped small because the bar is a single commissioned source with no second estimate.

findings.finding: The Q2 release and presentation said H2 starts with a better cost base, strong order intake at the end of Q2 (55 MSEK, including major defence orders), a larger backlog, 'increased market activity in Finland end of Q2' and no significant restructuring costs in H2, so Q3 should carry little of the 8 MSEK-type charge that hit Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The same constructive H2 language in July did not stop a 16% fall on the Q2 miss.
findings.original_quote: Vi går in i det andra halvåret med en förbättrad kostnadsstruktur, stärkt orderingång och en marknad som visar positiva signaler. (We enter H2 with an improved cost structure, stronger order intake and a market showing positive signals.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. This is what the company told the market to expect, and ABG cut estimates anyway three months later, so it is sized near zero.

findings.finding: Finnish engineering peer Etteplan issued a profit warning on 16 Sep: demand had not developed as expected since the summer and project starts were delayed. Finland was the line that sank Prevas's Q2, and ABG expects Finland still soft in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Finland drove the Q2'26 miss and the -16% reaction.
findings.original_quote: Kesän jälkeen markkinakysyntä ei ole kehittynyt odotustemme mukaisesti ja hankkeiden käynnistymisessä on ollut viiveitä. (Since summer, market demand has not developed as we expected and project starts have been delayed.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: Prevas slid from 67.4 to 56.7 SEK between 4 and 16 Sep, ending on the day of the warning, and ABG has since built a soft Finland into the bar. It is a proxy, and Etteplan's release does not single out Finland and says demand is now improving.
findings.independence: Knowit Q3: 'Finland har det mest utmanande marknadsläget' (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b5c9055a2bb84e173a62665f53af5f707&lang=sv&src=listed)

findings.finding: Former CEO and current board member Johan Strid sold 68,216 Prevas B shares (about 60% of the 112,328 listed on the company's board page) at 65.00-66.69 SEK on 7-9 Sep 2026, seven weeks before the print and after the Q2 report. The only insider buys since Q2 are token amounts (about 1.4-1.5k shares each from the CEO, chair and one director on 17 Jul).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior insider-sale episode identified for this name.
findings.original_quote: Johan Strid | Styrelseledamot | Avyttring | Prevas AB ser. B | 2026-09-08 | 42 405 | 65,23 SEK
findings.why_not_priced: Public on FI's register since 9 Sep, and the stock fell about 13% over the following week, so it is mostly in the price. It was filed outside any closed period, so it does not show knowledge of Q3.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 has the same 66 weekdays as Q3 2025, with no Swedish public holidays in either, and Prevas's Q2 release confirms a flat working-day count for H1. So the working-day calendar does not move Q3 either way, unlike Q1-Q3 2025 when a 10 MSEK calendar hit was disclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prevas reports the working-day count every quarter; the 2025 calendar effect was part of a weak 9M.
findings.why_not_priced: Neutral by construction; filed so that the bar comparison is clean.
findings.independence: Calendar computation (66 vs 66 weekdays, Q3 2025 vs Q3 2026).

baseline_tension: Mostly agrees: priced_lean -0.22 is just the 20-day run-up (anchor_covered false), and the slightly positive lean from peers and the lowered bar is offset by public negatives the September slide already absorbed, so nothing here strongly contradicts the price.
language_note: Prevas, Knowit and AFRY release in Swedish and English at once, so the primary documents added nothing language-specific; the Swedish versions were read for quotes.
The Finnish-language Etteplan profit warning carried the 'demand not developed as expected since summer' wording; English wire coverage was not checked separately.
Finansinspektionen's insider register (Swedish interface) gave the dated insider sale by the former CEO, which no English source surfaced.
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry; the Swedish press had no Q3 preview.
lessons_applied: The bar is unsourced or disputed (a single commissioned ABG estimate with no second source): the lowered-bar finding was capped from +0.5 to +0.3 and p_up moved from 54 to 53.
A proxy is a hypothesis (peer read-through): the Knowit/AFRY finding fell from +1.0 to +0.8, its weight in p_up reduced.
A finding about what the company already told the market: the Q2 H2 statements fell from +0.3 to +0.2.
Positioning is the thing to beat and the negatives were already priced (the September slide): Etteplan fell from -0.8 to -0.5 and the insider sale from -0.5 to -0.4.
Understatement is the systematic error and the history is a lower bound: abs_move held at 8 (observed print-day moves 1.3-22%, median about 5%), not shrunk.
anchor_covered false means the zero short is the truncation floor: stated as such in positioning_check.
